root_cause_analysis.symptom: Five hours of debugging; Claude repeatedly writes non-schema fields (most recently plan_label) and stale states; auto-commit hooks fill master git log with 13+ entries in 90 minutes; image fetcher reports false success when upstream calls all fail; data file china-20260412-092624 contains 8 distinct active bugs across timeline/transportation/budget/meals/entertainment/attractions/shopping.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Harness has zero write-time schema enforcement on data/**/*.json (PreToolUse on Write/Edit only does path-block; PostToolUse only runs git checkpoint hook; deploy-time verify-plan-integrity.py runs only at generate-and-deploy.sh time). Combined with: (a) save.py exposing --batch flag and lacking --day mandate, allowing multi-day batch overwrites; (b) auto-commit hooks (posttool-git-checkpoint.sh + stop-git-commit.sh) calling git commit directly which advances master HEAD; (c) fetch-images-batch.py broad except clauses swallowing all errors; (d) schemas/timeline.schema.json:77-80 leaking plan_label as a valid property in a prior unauthorized cycle; (e) no cross-file referential-integrity check anywhere in the pipeline.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: Multiple — schema plan_label leak source unknown without bisect (out of scope this cycle); auto-commit hooks present since at least 2026-04-04 per file headers; broad excepts in fetch-images-batch.py legacy. The user did not request bisect; root cause is structural absence of write-time gates rather than a single regression commit.
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: save.py --batch was introduced for legitimate multi-agent atomic saves (rollback semantics). Auto-commit hooks were introduced for crash-recovery. Broad excepts in fetch-images-batch.py were introduced as defensive programming. plan_label was unilaterally added by a prior Claude cycle as a 'helpful extension' the user never authorized. None of these were 'wrong' per se — they accumulated into a system where agents have many ways to write bad data and few enforced gates.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: The user's explicit binding ('永久根本性地彻底修复', '批量操作永久禁止') requires structural impossibility, not just discipline. The current harness ASSUMES agents follow rules; the spec demands the harness ENFORCE rules.

novelty_check.rationale: Parent attempted regex on Bash strings (parsing shell quoting with regex - undecidable in general). This attempt operates at the structured tool_input.file_path / tool_input.content payload (JSON-parseable, no quoting ambiguity). Auto-commit redirect to refs/checkpoints/<branch> via git update-ref + commit-tree (never advancing HEAD) is a novel L5 infrastructure approach not previously attempted in this codebase. save.py --day N mandatory mode makes batch operations structurally impossible at the API level (L4 CLI gating) rather than relying on agent discipline (parent's L1 approach).
